history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It seems completely dead as far as the network goes.

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send picture messages. However, your recent bills are paid, and your contract is still active.

Since your line is suspended but there are no overdue bills or contract issues, I can attempt to resume your service now. Once resumed, you’ll need to reboot your device to restore network connectivity.

Would you like me to proceed with resuming your line?
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line.

Your line has been resumed and is now active. Please reboot your device to restore your network service. After restarting, you should have full service again, including the ability to send picture messages.

If you still experience issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further troubleshoot.

history.content: I rebooted my device successfully, but I still have no service—there are no signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no service, let's troubleshoot your device further.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- “No SIM” or “SIM error” message
- Any signal bars at all (even if they are empty)
- Any other unusual icons

This information will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
I actually see the Airplane Mode icon and a 'No Signal' icon in my status bar. It looks like Airplane Mode might be on.

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service. Please turn off Airplane Mode on your device. Once it is off, check if your signal bars return and if you can use your phone normally.

Let me know if turning off Airplane Mode restores your service or if you still have issues.
Airplane mode is now OFF, but I still have no signal—no bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for confirming. Since Airplane Mode is off but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Please check if your phone displays any messages such as “No SIM,” “SIM error,” or “SIM locked.” 

If you don’t see any such messages, please try removing your SIM card and reinserting it (reseating the SIM). After doing this, check if your phone regains signal.

Let me know what you find or if you need guidance on how to reseat your SIM card.
I removed and reinserted the SIM card. My phone says the SIM status is active, but I still have no service—no signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for reseating your SIM card and confirming its status is active. Since your SIM is active, Airplane Mode is off, and your line is not suspended, the next step is to check your phone’s network settings.

Sometimes, incorrect network settings (APN) can cause a complete loss of service. Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if there is no APN set. If you’re unsure, I can guide you through resetting your APN settings to default, which often resolves this issue.

Would you like instructions on how to reset your APN settings?
Yes, please guide me through resetting my APN settings.

Here’s how to reset your APN (Access Point Name) settings to default:

1. Go to your phone’s Settings app.
2. Find and select “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Tap on “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Networks.”
4. Select “Access Point Names” or “APN.”
5. Look for an option to “Reset to default” or “Reset settings.” Tap it to restore the default APN settings.

After resetting your APN settings, please reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Once your phone restarts, check if you have service and can use your phone normally.

Let me know if you need help with any of these steps or if your service is restored after completing them.
I reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my device as you instructed, but I still have no service—there are no signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for following all the troubleshooting steps. Since your line is active, your SIM is recognized, Airplane Mode is off, and you have reset your APN settings and rebooted, but you still have no service, this may indicate a more complex technical issue.

At this point, I will transfer you to a human agent who can provide advanced support and further investigate the problem.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
